name: Melty Summer
source:
This game will bring you to good old Japan.
After the death of his father, "Yoshikazu" returned to his hometown. There, he meets his childhood friend "KANADE" and high school girl "NENEKO" again and becomes friends. The days were quiet and fulfilling, but Yoshikazu felt a sense of incongruity.

What is "truth"?

[From [url=https://little-j-plusplus.itch.io/melty-summer]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这款游戏将带你回到美好的古老日本。
父亲去世后，“义和”回到了家乡。在那里，他再次遇见了儿时好友“奏”和高中女生“NENEKO”，并成为了朋友。日子过得平静而充实，但良和却有一种不协调的感觉。

什么是“真理”？

[来自[url=https://little-j-plusplus.itch.io/melty-summer]Itch.io[/url]]
